lines.en: label bar50:
scene funnydildoscene1
I make my way over to the bar to hang out with Sana for a bit.
lines.zh: 我去酒吧陪 Sana 待一会儿。

lines.en: She’s cleaning off the counter when I arrive...which, thanks to my above average deductive reasoning, I know means there were likely {i}real{/i} customers tonight.
lines.zh: 我到的时候她正在擦吧台……多亏我高于平均水平的推理能力，我知道这意味着今晚大概来过{i}真的{/i}客人。

lines.en: Could it be that handing out a few fliers and hiring an ex Yakuza wife actually increased business somehow?
lines.zh: 难道说，发了些传单、又雇了个前黑帮老婆，真的把生意带起来了？

lines.en: : You certainly look happy tonight.
lines.zh: : 你今晚看起来心情不错。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 有吗？

lines.en: : Unless you’re smiling for no apparent reason.
lines.zh: : 除非你是在毫无理由地笑。

lines.en: : If that's the case, allow me to change that last sentence to, “You certainly look menacing tonight.”
lines.zh: : 如果是这样，请允许我把上一句改成：“你今晚看起来挺吓人的。”

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene2
: I...think happy is closer to the right answer.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得“开心”更接近正确答案。

lines.en: : But not {i}entirely{/i} the right answer.
lines.zh: : 但还不是{i}完全{/i}正确。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene3
: I think that maybe...relieved is the word you’re looking for.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……你要找的词大概是“松了口气”。

lines.en: : It’s been a while since we had actual customers.
lines.zh: : 我们已经很久没有真正的客人了。

lines.en: : Even those two old ladies who used to hang out in the back of the room stopped showing up a while ago.
lines.zh: : 连那两个以前总窝在房间后面的老太太也好一阵子没来了。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene1
: But...tonight, we had a handful of people that I’ve never even seen before.
lines.zh: : 不过……今晚来了几个我从来没见过的客人。

lines.en: : And how many of them ordered drinks that you didn’t have the ingredients for?
lines.zh: : 其中有多少人点的酒是你们没有原料做的？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene4
: All of them...
lines.zh: : 全部……

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene1
: But...they were understanding when I told them we could only serve beer and wine for the night.
lines.zh: : 不过……我告诉他们今晚只能供应啤酒和葡萄酒时，他们都很理解。

lines.en: : And...now I guess I have...more ammunition in...getting my mom to order actual liquor.
lines.zh: : 而且……这下我算是有……更多弹药……能催我妈进点真正的烈酒了。

lines.en: : Does Sara even have the money to get actual liquor?
lines.zh: : Sara 有钱进真正的烈酒吗？

lines.en: : Does Sara what now?
lines.zh: : Sara 怎么了？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene5
Sara and Yuki come out of the back room and make their way over to Sana and me.
lines.zh: Sara 和 Yuki 从后房走出来，朝 Sana 和我这边过来。

lines.en: Sara stands defiantly behind the counter and Yuki-
lines.zh: Sara 挑衅似的往吧台后面一站，而 Yuki——

lines.en: Well...Yuki just stands, I guess.
lines.zh: 嗯……Yuki 就是站着吧。

lines.en: : Yo.
: Good evening, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚上好，Sensei。

lines.en: : Now, what were you saying about having enough money to buy {i}actual{/i} liquor?
lines.zh: : 那么，你刚才说我有钱买{i}真正的{/i}烈酒，是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Oh. I was just asking if you had enough money to buy actual liquor.
lines.zh: : 哦。我只是问你有没有足够的钱买真正的烈酒。

lines.en: : Reasonable question.
lines.zh: : 合理的问题。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene6
: Hmph.
: I do recall a time where that may have been a worry of mine.
lines.zh: : 我确实记得有那么一阵子，这可能还算个问题。

lines.en: : But I’ll have you know that the one and only Sakaki-Bar-A is back on top.
lines.zh: : 不过我得让你知道，独一无二的 Sakaki-Bar-A 又杀回来了。

lines.en: : Please tell me the name of this place isn’t actually the “Sakaki-Bar-A.”
lines.zh: : 请告诉我这地方的名字真不叫“Sakaki-Bar-A”。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene7
: Wait, you really didn’t know that?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真不知道？

lines.en: : You’ve been coming here for how long now?
lines.zh: : 你都来这儿多久了？

lines.en: : Good question, Sara. Why don't you answer it for me?
lines.zh: : 问得好，Sara。要不你来替我回答？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene8
: Um...I know we...had a good night, but...I don’t think we should let {i}one{/i} good night go to our heads...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我知道我们……今晚不错，不过……我觉得不该因为{i}一个{/i}好晚上就冲昏头脑……

lines.en: : We...still have a lot of work to do...
lines.zh: : 我们……还有很多事要做……

lines.en: : I know, I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。

lines.en: : But, since all three of us did wonderfully tonight, I was thinking that maybe we could all go out for a little celebration.
lines.zh: : 不过，既然我们三个今晚都干得漂亮，我在想，要不大家一起出去小小庆祝一下。

lines.en: : Okay. Guess I’ll just go fuck myself then.
lines.zh: : 好啊。看来我就自己一边玩去吧。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene9
: Okay, the {i}four{/i} of us can go out for a little celebration.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那{i}四{/i}个人一起出去小小庆祝一下。

lines.en: : Is that really the best course of action?
lines.zh: : 这真的是最好的做法吗？

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t it be?
lines.zh: : 为什么不是？

lines.en: : I mean, I take it that you finally generated some sort of profit tonight. It would be a bit of a shame to just blow that all on a post work celebration, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你们今晚总算有了点盈利，就这么全花在下班后的庆功上，多少有点可惜吧？

lines.en: : Sensei is...actually giving good advice for a change...
lines.zh: : Sensei……难得给出了个像样的建议……

lines.en: : Hey, what happened to all of that stuff about how I helped you face your fear of people and pasta?
lines.zh: : 嘿，那些“我帮你克服了怕人和怕意面”的话都哪去了？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene10
: Guh...
: It’s not like I was planning on going out to some fancy restaurant or anything...
lines.zh: : 我又没打算去什么高级餐厅……

lines.en: : Yuki told me about some place she normally goes to in the old district, so I was thinking that maybe we could all grab dinner there before heading home.
lines.zh: : Yuki 跟我说了她常去的老城区一家店，我想着要不我们先去那儿吃个晚饭再回家。

lines.en: : Tojo Ramen?
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen？

lines.en: : You know it.
lines.zh: : 你懂的。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene11
: The old district is...a little too far for me, I think...
lines.zh: : 老城区……对我来说有点太远了吧……

lines.en: : I’m...kind of tired from working all night and...I don’t even think the buses are running right now...
lines.zh: : 我……忙了一整晚有点累，而且……这会儿公交车大概也停了……

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene12
: But we were all gonna ride on Yuki’s motorcycle together and it was gonna be fuuuuun...
lines.zh: : 可我们本来要一起坐 Yuki 的摩托车去的，会很好玩的……

lines.en: : I...don’t even know if that’s legal?...
lines.zh: : 我……都不知道这样合不合法？……

lines.en: : It’s not, but no one’s gonna fuckin’ care.
lines.zh: : 不合法，但没人他妈的会在意。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming I’d just be walking.
lines.zh: : 那我大概得自己走过去吧。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene13
: Of course not! You’d be riding with us!
lines.zh: : 当然不是！你会跟我们一起坐！

lines.en: : Four people on one motorcycle? I’ll pass.
lines.zh: : 四个人挤一辆摩托车？我就不参与了。

lines.en: : You passed when it was just two as well, ya fuckin' pussy.
lines.zh: : 只有两个人的时候你也没上，你这个怂包。

lines.en: : Yuki, come on. Not in front of one of my students.
lines.zh: : Yuki，拜托。别当着我学生的面。

lines.en: : It’s okay, Sensei...I’m...a little afraid of motorcycles as well...
lines.zh: : 没关系的，Sensei……我也……有点怕摩托车……

lines.en: : I’m not-
lines.zh: : 我不是——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. We all know how brave and strong you are.
lines.zh: : 是是是。我们都知道你有多勇敢多强壮。

lines.en: : Sara, not you too. You’re supposed to always be on my side.
lines.zh: : Sara，连你也这样。你不是应该永远站在我这边的吗。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene14
: Put a ring on it and maybe I will be~
lines.zh: : 给我戴上戒指，也许我就站你这边了~

lines.en: : Pass.
lines.zh: : 免了。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene15
: At least hesitate a little, jerk!
lines.zh: : 至少犹豫一下啊，混蛋！

lines.en: : Brutal.
lines.zh: : 太狠了。

lines.en: : Um...if Sensei and I...both don’t really want to go...
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果 Sensei 和我……都不太想去的话……

lines.en: : I guess we could stay here and...close up...
lines.zh: : 要不我们就留在这儿……打烊收尾……

lines.en: : As long as I don’t have to actually do anything.
lines.zh: : 只要不用我真的干活就行。

lines.en: : I’ve...already handled most of it, so...
lines.zh: : 我……已经做得差不多了，所以……

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene16
: You’re really sure you don’t want to come, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，你真的确定不去吗？

lines.en: : It’s been a while since the two of us have gone out to dinner together.
lines.zh: : 我们俩好久没一起出去吃饭了。

lines.en: : We could always go another time. I just...don’t really want to right now...
lines.zh: : 以后再去也行。我只是……现在不太想去……

lines.en: : If...that’s what you really want...okay...
lines.zh: : 如果……你真的这么想……好吧……

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene17
: I’m leaving her in your hands then, got it?
lines.zh: : 那我把她交给你了，明白吗？

lines.en: : It will be good practice for when you decide to settle down with me and become Sana’s new daddy.
lines.zh: : 就当是提前练练手，等你哪天决定跟我安定下来，当 Sana 的新爸爸。

lines.en: : I really wish all of you mothers would stop trying to get me to be your daughter’s new father.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你们这些当妈的别再一个个都想让我当你们女儿的新爸爸。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene18
: Yo! Don’t fuckin’ lump me in with that shit. I ain’t ever asked for that.
lines.zh: : 喂！别他妈的把我也算进去。我可从没要求过这个。

lines.en: : Not {i}yet{/i} you haven’t.
lines.zh: : 目前{i}还{/i}没有而已。

lines.en: : Ain’t gonna fuckin’ happen, man. Quit while you’re ahead.
lines.zh: : 绝对不可能，老兄。见好就收吧。

lines.en: : How am I-
lines.zh: : 我怎么就——

lines.en: : As much as I’d love to hang around and listen to you two “not flirt” with each other, I’d also love to eat before it’s time for me to pass out for the night.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想留下来听你们俩“不是在调情”，但我也想在今晚昏睡过去之前吃点东西。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene19
: You good to go then?
lines.zh: : 那你可以走了吗？

lines.en: : Should probably put on a jacket if you don’t wanna get cold. Body heat’s not good for shit when you’ve got the wind blowin’ right at you.
lines.zh: : 你要是不想冻着，最好套件外套。风迎面吹的时候，体温可一点用都没有。

lines.en: : It’s near the door. I’m ready whenever.
lines.zh: : 就在门边。我随时都行。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene20
: Be good.
lines.zh: : 乖乖的。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay?
: Night, man. See you around or whatever.
lines.zh: : 晚安，老兄。回头见什么的。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene21
Sara and Yuki make their way out of the store, leaving Sana and me alone in the bar for what I imagine is the millionth time.
lines.zh: Sara 和 Yuki 走出店门，又只剩 Sana 和我两个人在酒吧里——我猜这已经是第一百万次了。

lines.en: Tonight feels a little different, though.
lines.zh: 不过今晚感觉有点不一样。

lines.en: For one, it’s the first time I’ve ever had to watch her really clean anything.
lines.zh: 其一，这是我第一次看她真的打扫什么。

lines.en: But not only that, we’re still coming off of a relatively awkward and uncomfortable exchange about her brother that I really hope doesn’t come up again any time soon.
lines.zh: 还不止如此，我们刚经历过一场关于她哥哥的、相当尴尬不自在的对话，我真希望短时间内别再提起来。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene22
: So...I guess it’s just us again...
lines.zh: : 所以……又只剩我们两个了……

lines.en: : I guess it is.
lines.zh: : 看来是的。

lines.en: : What else do you have to do before we can get out of here?
lines.zh: : 在走之前你还有什么要做的？

lines.en: : Are we...going somewhere?
lines.zh: : 我们……要去哪儿吗？

lines.en: : Because I wasn’t really lying about being tired...
lines.zh: : 因为我说的累不是假的……

lines.en: : Well, if you’re closing, there’s not really any point in hanging around, is there?
lines.zh: : 嗯，既然你要打烊了，待在这儿也没什么意义了，对吧？

lines.en: : I figured I’d just walk you back to the dorm or something like-
lines.zh: : 我想着就送你走回宿舍什么的——

lines.en: I inadvertently pause when I remember an important detail about the thing I literally {i}just{/i} thought about {i}not{/i} thinking about.
lines.zh: 我无意中顿住了——我想起了关于那件我{i}刚刚{/i}才决定{i}不要{/i}去想的事情的一个重要细节。

lines.en: If her brother was killed while walking home, is something like that some sort of trigger for her?
lines.zh: 如果她哥哥是在回家的路上被杀的，那这种事会不会成为她的某种触发点？

lines.en: Is the sheer idea of walking home enough to evoke the same negative memories a lock of hair can?
lines.zh: 光是“走回家”这个念头，就足以唤起和一绺头发一样的痛苦回忆吗？

lines.en: These are the things I’m forced to think about for her sake now.
lines.zh: 这些就是我现在为了她不得不去想的事。

lines.en: All because she wanted to make something of hers mine.
lines.zh: 全都是因为她想把自己的某样东西变成我的。

lines.en: : ...Sensei?
lines.zh: : ……Sensei？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。

lines.en: : I just figured we’d walk back to the dorm or something.
lines.zh: : 我只是想着我们走回宿舍什么的。

lines.en: It wouldn’t be the first time anyway.
lines.zh: 反正也不是第一次了。

lines.en: I’m likely just overthinking things at this point.
lines.zh: 这会儿大概只是我想多了。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene23
: Sure...
: I’m just going to run up to my mom’s room to grab a few DVDs before we leave...
lines.zh: : 出发前我要上我妈房间拿几张 DVD……

lines.en: : Ayane’s been looking for a lot of...lighthearted romantic comedies lately and...I’m pretty sure my mom has a ton of those...
lines.zh: : Ayane 最近在找很多……轻松的浪漫喜剧……我妈那儿肯定有一大堆……

lines.en: : Don’t you need to finish cleaning first?
lines.zh: : 你不用先把卫生搞完吗？

lines.en: : I think it’s...clean enough, right?
lines.zh: : 我觉得……已经够干净了吧？

lines.en: : It’s not like we were...{i}extremely{/i} busy...
lines.zh: : 我们又没有……{i}特别{/i}忙……

lines.en: : Just...busier than normal...
lines.zh: : 只是……比平时忙一点……

lines.en: : Hey, you’re the employee. I’m just some guy who hangs out here and talks to you every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你才是员工。我只是个偶尔来这儿待着跟你聊两句的人。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene24
: Then...in that case...wait here.
lines.zh: : 那……这样的话……在这儿等我。

lines.en: : I’ll be right back.
lines.zh: : 我马上回来。

lines.en: scene black
Sana tosses the rag she’d been using to wipe down the counter into a large blue bin and quietly makes her way up the stairs.
lines.zh: Sana 把她擦吧台用的抹布扔进一个大蓝箱子里，轻手轻脚地上楼去了。

lines.en: I scan the room to see if maybe she missed a chair to push in or something like that.
lines.zh: 我扫了一圈，看看她是不是漏了哪把椅子没推进去之类的。

lines.en: I don’t really know how nice this place is supposed to look when it closes.
lines.zh: 我其实也不知道这地方打烊时该有多整洁。

lines.en: And it’s not like I’d actually {i}help{/i} either since I’m not being paid.
lines.zh: 再说我又没拿工资，也不至于真的{i}帮忙{/i}。

lines.en: But I could at least tell her about it when she comes back...
lines.zh: 不过等她回来，我至少可以告诉她一下……

lines.en: {i}Ten minutes later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}十分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: scene barnight
Sana still hasn’t come downstairs.
lines.zh: Sana 还没下楼。

lines.en: I was hoping things wouldn’t come to this as I am {i}also{/i} tired and really don’t want to summon the energy to go up there.
lines.zh: 我本来不想走到这一步的，毕竟我{i}也{/i}累了，实在不想打起精神上楼去。

lines.en: But I guess a real concern with her is that if a dresser fell down or something like that, she could be stuck beneath it for life.
lines.zh: 不过对她来说，一个现实的隐忧是：万一衣柜什么的倒了，她可能一辈子都被压在下面。

lines.en: I will save you, Sana.
lines.zh: 我来救你，Sana。

lines.en: Granted, I probably would have heard something if a dresser fell down or...
lines.zh: 话说回来，衣柜要是真倒了，我应该也听见动静了……

lines.en: Ugh.
lines.zh: 唉。

lines.en: Fuck it.
lines.zh: 管他呢。

lines.en: I sigh to myself and tap into my energy reserves and head for the stairs.
lines.zh: 我叹了口气，调动起仅剩的体力，朝楼梯走去。

jump funnydildox
label funnydildox:
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene25
scene funnydildoscene26
: Hey. Any bookshelves fall down in here?
lines.zh: : 嘿。这儿有书架倒了吗？

lines.en: : Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene27
: Is everything-
lines.zh: : 一切都还——

lines.en: : Ha.
: It’s just...
lines.zh: : 它就这么……

lines.en: : It’s just...sitting there...
lines.zh: : 就这么……躺在那儿……

lines.en: : Do you know what that is?
lines.zh: : 你知道那是什么吗？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene28
: Of course I know what that is! I’m a [teenager]! I...know things!
lines.zh: : 我当然知道那是什么！我可是个[teenager]！我……懂的！

lines.en: : Okay, but you’re also Sana, so...
lines.zh: : 好吧，可你也是 Sana，所以……

lines.en: : Be quiet! Why are you even up here?!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！你上来干什么？！

lines.en: : You’ve been gone for ten minutes. Is this what you’ve been doing the whole time?
lines.zh: : 你都去了十分钟了。你这段时间一直在干这个？

lines.en: : Why is it just laying there on the bed?!
lines.zh: : 它为什么就这么躺在床上？！

lines.en: : Okay, so I guess this {i}is{/i} what you’ve been doing the whole time.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来你{i}确实{/i}一直在干这个。

lines.en: : Things like that should stay hidden!
lines.zh: : 那种东西应该藏起来才对！

lines.en: : Or at least on a...shelf or something!
lines.zh: : 至少也该放在……架子上什么的！

lines.en: : If you don’t like where it is...put it back?
lines.zh: : 你要是不喜欢它待的地方……放回去不就行了？

lines.en: : How?! I don’t want to touch it!
lines.zh: : 怎么放？！我根本不想碰它！

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene29
: Fine. I’ll just put it back then.
lines.zh: : 行吧。那我来放回去。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene30
: Ahhh no! That’s even worse!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊不要！那样更糟！

lines.en: : I’ll just...
: I’ll do it!
lines.zh: : 我来放！

lines.en: : Why is this even a thing you-
lines.zh: : 这到底有什么好——

lines.en: : Just...shut up already!
lines.zh: : 你……给我闭嘴！

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene31
: Ohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygodohmygod.
lines.zh: : 我的天我的天我的天我的天我的天我的天我的天。

lines.en: : Couldn’t you just...leave it there?

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene38
: Why are these here?
lines.zh: : 为什么这些会在这儿？

lines.en: : Why is what here?

lines.en: : So why are these here?

lines.en: : Why would I know? It's not like they're mine.

lines.en: I’ve never even used a condom with Sara before.

lines.en: I don’t know if she’s just holding onto them in case she...decides to start practicing safe sex or something, but I don’t really care either way.

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene39
: Why does she have them, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，她为什么会有这些？

lines.en: : Sana, do you think I’m somehow involved in this?
lines.zh: : Sana，你觉得这事儿跟我有关系？

lines.en: : Should I not?
lines.zh: : 难道我不该这么想吗？

lines.en: : That’s what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 我就是这个意思。

lines.en: : And all of those things she says about wanting to marry you?
lines.zh: : 那她说的那些想嫁给你的话呢？

lines.en: : Is that just you two joking around?
lines.zh: : 那些也只是你们在开玩笑？

lines.en: : None of that has anything to do with-
lines.zh: : 那些都跟这事没——

: How gullible do you think I am?!

lines.en: : Sana, relax.

lines.en: : No!
: Why are these here?!

lines.en: You know-

lines.en: But I’m being yelled at right now for something I don’t even play a part in.
lines.zh: 可我现在却在为一件根本没我份的事挨骂。

lines.en: Now, if she were to have actually caught me in the act, that would be another story.
lines.zh: 要是她真当场撞见我，那就是另一回事了。

lines.en: But I should be able to get out of this.
lines.zh: 但这次我应该能蒙混过去。

lines.en: I was made for this sort of thing, after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟，我就是为这种事而生的。

lines.en: : Why not ask your mom about it before you go jumping to any conclusions?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不先问问你妈，别急着下结论？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene41
: Why not ask my mom?...
lines.zh: : 为什么不问我妈？……

lines.en: : Probably because I’ve told her over and over again that I don’t want her to have {i}that{/i} sort of relationship with you.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为我一遍又一遍地跟她说过，我不希望她跟你发展成{i}那种{/i}关系。

lines.en: : She’ll just tell me what I want to hear even if it's a lie.
lines.zh: : 她只会挑我想听的说，哪怕那是谎话。

lines.en: : Maybe she’s just...keeping them in case I change my mind and decide to be with her after all?
lines.zh: : 也许她只是……留着以防我哪天改变主意，真的跟她在一起？

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene42
: Sana, I-
lines.zh: : Sana，我——

lines.en: : It’s one thing if it’s with Ayane...but my mom?
lines.zh: : 如果是跟 Ayane 也就算了……可我妈？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how that makes me feel?
lines.zh: : 你知道那让我是什么感受吗？

lines.en: : How {i}what{/i} makes you feel, Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana，{i}什么{/i}让你是什么感受？

lines.en: : I already told you this has nothing to do with me.
lines.zh: : 我已经说了这跟我没关系。

lines.en: : Maybe...Maki just gave them to her in case of an emergency or something.
lines.zh: : 也许……是 Maki 给她的，留着应急什么的。

lines.en: : That would sure be convenient, huh?
lines.zh: : 那可真是太巧了，是吧？

lines.en: : You’re the only man she talks to, Sensei.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你是她唯一会说话的男人。

lines.en: : And you came right up to her room when I never came back downstairs.
lines.zh: : 我没下楼的时候，你直接就上她房间来了。

lines.en: : Which means you’ve been in here before.
lines.zh: : 也就是说你以前来过这里。

lines.en: : Which means you've-
lines.zh: : 也就是说你——

lines.en: : I’ve carried her up the stairs when she’s gotten black out drunk.
lines.zh: : 她喝到断片的时候，我把她背上过楼。

lines.en: : Oh yeah?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : What else?
lines.zh: : 还有呢？

lines.en: : What do you mean what else?

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene40
: I MEAN WHAT ELSE!
lines.zh: : 我问还有呢！

lines.en: : DON’T LIE TO ME!

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, Sana. Calm the fuck down and listen to me for a second.
lines.zh: : 老天，Sana。你他妈的冷静一下，听我说几句。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene39
: Whatever you think is going on...it’s not.
lines.zh: : 不管你以为发生了什么……都不是。

lines.en: : Your mom and I are just friends.
lines.zh: : 你妈和我只是朋友。

lines.en: : And even if we weren’t, do you really think either one of us would be dumb enough to just leave condoms lying around?
lines.zh: : 就算不只是朋友，你真觉得我们俩会有那么蠢，把避孕套就这么随便乱放？

lines.en: : I mean...your mom left an actual sex toy on her bed. I think it’s safe to assume that she might just be trying to mess with you or something.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你妈把个真的性玩具就那么摆在床上。我觉得基本可以断定，她可能只是想捉弄你什么的。

lines.en: : Really. Just try talking to her about it instead of jumping to conclusions.
lines.zh: : 说真的。去跟她谈谈，别急着下结论。

lines.en: : But it was...such an easy conclusion to jump to...
lines.zh: : 可那是个……太容易得出的结论了……

lines.en: : I never liked how quickly you two started being...{i}friendly{/i} with one another.
lines.zh: : 我一直不喜欢你们俩那么快就变得……那么{i}亲近{/i}。

lines.en: : I was...always afraid of this happening.
lines.zh: : 我一直……都怕会变成这样。

lines.en: : Afraid of how you’d realize how good of a match you are and just...
lines.zh: : 怕你总有一天会发现你们有多般配，然后就……

lines.en: : Just what, Sana?

lines.en: : Can you...

: And I swear to do anything you ask of me if you find out I’m lying about that.
lines.zh: : 而且我发誓，要是你发现我在这件事上撒了谎，你要我做什么都行。

lines.en: : Anything?
lines.zh: : 什么都行？

lines.en: : Is there something in particular you want?

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene43
: ...yeah.
: I want things to stay the way they are now...
lines.zh: : 我希望一切就保持现在这样……

lines.en: : The way things are right now is pretty bad. You’re crying and holding an unidentified condom in your hand.
lines.zh: : 现在这样可不怎么样。你一边哭，一边手里攥着一个来源不明的避孕套。

lines.en: : Not like that, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思，Sensei……

lines.en: : With you at arms length...
lines.zh: : 跟你保持一臂之遥……

lines.en: : From everyone...
lines.zh: : 跟所有人都保持距离……

lines.en: : Everyone?
lines.zh: : 所有人？

lines.en: : Everyone.
lines.zh: : 所有人。

lines.zh: : 你也看到了我进步了多少……

lines.zh: : 而且……你现在连我最大的一个秘密都知道了……

lines.zh: : 要是事情变了……我说不定也会变……

lines.en: : And it wouldn’t be...in a good way...
lines.zh: : 而且不会是……往好的方向变……

lines.en: : So please...promise me...you’ll stay away from my mom...
lines.zh: : 所以求你……答应我……离我妈远一点……

lines.en: : Sure. But first, I’m going to need you to apologize for accusing me of all of this.
lines.zh: : 好。不过首先，你得为这些指控向我道歉。

lines.en: scene funnydildoscene44
: If I’m wrong...which I really...hope I am...

lines.en: : Like I said, they’re probably just there because of Maki or something.
lines.zh: : 我也说了，大概就是 Maki 什么的留下的。

lines.en: : Or, maybe Sara is weird and uses them on the dildo you grabbed off the bed so she doesn’t get pregnant with a giant rubber baby.
lines.zh: : 或者，也许 Sara 就是个怪人，拿它们套在你从床上拿起来的那根按摩棒上，免得怀上一个巨大的橡胶宝宝。

lines.en: : Come on. Are you really going to keep crying after that?
lines.zh: : 拜托。听到这个你还要继续哭吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : Just for a little while longer...
lines.zh: : 就再哭一小会儿……

lines.en: scene black
So-
lines.zh: 那么——

lines.en: It appears that I managed to nearly avoid a head on collision.
lines.zh: 看来我差点就避开了一场正面相撞。

lines.en: And, just as all good head on collisions do-
lines.zh: 而就像所有精彩的正面相撞一样——

lines.en: It came out of nowhere.
lines.zh: 它来得毫无预兆。

lines.en: And to think that I didn’t even have to break any promises in order to escape.
lines.zh: 想想看，我为了脱身，连一个承诺都不用违背。

lines.en: Would I have still agreed to her promise if she had asked me to stay away from Sara entirely?
lines.zh: 要是她要求我彻底远离 Sara，我还会答应吗？

lines.en: Sure.
lines.zh: 当然会。

lines.en: But I’d break it.
lines.zh: 但我会违背。

lines.en: Promising that a few contraceptives don’t belong to me is, frankly, much better- as it allows me to fall asleep a little easier in knowing that there was one less lie told tonight.
lines.zh: 坦白说，承诺“那几只避孕套不是我的”要好得多——这样我至少能因为今晚少说了一个谎，睡得稍微安稳一点。

lines.en: Though, of course many people would believe this entire ordeal was what you’d call “lying by omission.”
lines.zh: 当然，很多人会觉得这整件事就是所谓的“隐瞒式撒谎”。

lines.en: That’s not lying at all.
lines.zh: 那根本不算撒谎。

lines.en: It’s bending the truth in a way that’s convenient for everyone.
lines.zh: 那只是把真相掰成对大家都方便的样子。

lines.en: I’m doing Sana a favor by {i}secretly{/i} fucking her mother instead of letting her in on the secret.
lines.zh: 我{i}偷偷地{/i}跟她妈上床，而不让她知道这个秘密，其实是在帮 Sana。

lines.en: She can have a new secret. One I’ll make just for her.
lines.zh: 她可以有新的秘密。一个我专门为她造的秘密。

lines.en: It won’t possess the same value of the one she shared with me-
lines.zh: 它不会有她跟我分享的那个秘密那样的分量——

lines.en: But it will be our melatonin.
lines.zh: 但它会是我们的褪黑素。

lines.en: And allow us to dream a little bit easier.
lines.zh: 让我们能稍微安心地做个梦。

lines.en: I walk Sana back to the dorm and we ignore the last half hour of our lives.
lines.zh: 我送 Sana 回宿舍，我们谁都不提这半个小时里发生的事。
